# SupaPing

> SupaPing is a lightweight Supabase keep-alive and heartbeat monitoring
> tool for developers managing low-traffic Supabase projects.

SupaPing lets developers register a Supabase project, send heartbeat
requests, and review request outcomes, response times, and heartbeat
history from a dashboard.

SupaPing uses a scheduled Vercel Cron Job to call an API endpoint that
updates a dedicated keep-alive table in the user's Supabase project.
A successful heartbeat does not guarantee that Supabase's inactivity
pausing criteria have been satisfied.

## Product

- [Homepage](https://www.supaping.app/): Product overview, features,
  pricing information, and setup overview.
- [Dashboard](https://www.supaping.app/login): Access the SupaPing dashboard.

## Supabase Guides

- [Why Does Supabase Pause?](https://www.supaping.app/blog/why-does-supabase-pause):
  Understand project inactivity, pausing, and restoration options.
- [How to Keep a Supabase Project Active](https://www.supaping.app/blog/keep-supabase-project-active):
  Explore scheduled activity and approaches to managing low-traffic projects.
- [Supabase Keep-Alive With Cron Jobs](https://www.supaping.app/blog/supabase-keep-alive-cron):
  Learn about scheduled jobs, REST API requests, and database updates.
- [Supabase Keep-Alive Methods Compared](https://www.supaping.app/blog/supabase-keep-alive-methods):
  Compare common keep-alive approaches and their limitations.

## Official Reference

- [Supabase Free Project Pausing](https://supabase.com/docs/guides/platform/free-project-pausing):
  Consult the official documentation for current inactivity and pausing policies.
